title: Start
body:
Guada woke up behind schedule.
Her grandmother reminds her to finish her household duty,
but her friends are already waiting and need to go to school.
What should she do?
[[ A. She should leave quietly and do the household duty later |option1]]
[[ B. Guada should handle the responsibility first even if she will be late. |option2]]
[[ C. She should ask for permission to complete it after school.|option3]]
